You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Egwi, Etche LGA survey stations. Interpreted layer model from the published survey:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 295.88 | 0.54518 | 0.54518
2 | 798.6 | 3.5924 | 4.1376
3 | 864.62 | 2.1559 | 6.2935
4 | 1810.2 | 37.957 | 37.25
5 | 5634.2 | - | -

The paper labels this station's curve as A-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station Egwi, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the paper's curve-type label does not fit the layer values.

**Site Note — Station Egwi, Etche LGA**

Five geoelectric layers were resolved to about 44 m. Layer 1 (295.9 Ω·m, 0.55 m) is thin topsoil. Layer 2 (798.6 Ω·m, 3.59 m) and Layer 3 (864.6 Ω·m, 2.16 m) form a sandy near-surface unit with closely similar resistivities. Layer 4 (1810.2 Ω·m, ~38 m) is a thick, coarser sand horizon, and Layer 5 (5634.2 Ω·m, infinite) is a very resistive sand/gravel basal unit.

Resistivity increases monotonically with depth (295.9 < 798.6 < 864.6 < 1810.2 < 5634.2), giving three triplets all of type A: AAA, written simply as A. This confirms the published A-type label.

Drilling note: the quoted depth to base of Layer 4 (37.25 m) is inconsistent with the cumulative thickness (~44.25 m); verify before setting screen depths. Target the Layer 4–5 sands, expecting generally low clay content and possible low yield in the most resistive zones.
